verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a public developer surface for POS. POS UI extensions are scaffolded with Shopify CLI and expose APIs such as shopify.storage, toast and presentModal, and extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(). However, these APIs extend the in-store interface from inside the app; the evidence shows no documented API that lets an external agent drive POS operations such as carts, checkout or staff actions. missing for 10: documented external/programmatic API for driving POS actions, explicit Admin API coverage of POS-specific resources, auth/rate-limit docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
